components.name: Shared host control
components.description: Theme-aware default for a trusted host control; semantic action variants are separate.
components.css: .ds-host-control { font: inherit; min-height: 44px; min-width: 44px; border: 1px solid var(--ui-border, #dce2e8); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--ui-surface, #ffffff); color: var(--ui-foreground, #192638); padding: 6px 12px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-host-control:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--ui-background, #ffffff); } .ds-host-control:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ui-accent, #245aca); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-host-control:disabled { opacity: .5; cursor: default; }

components.name: Labeled field
components.description: Visible label, quiet field surface and a primary input target.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; color: var(--ui-foreground, #192638); } .ds-field > span { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 550; } .ds-field input { font: inherit; width: 100%; min-height: 44px; border: 1px solid var(--ui-border, #dce2e8); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--ui-surface, #ffffff); color: var(--ui-foreground, #192638); padding: 10px 12px; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ui-accent, #245aca); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-field input:disabled { opacity: .55; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Tab navigation
components.description: Scrollable tabs show selection with an accent underline.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ui-border, #dce2e8); margin-bottom: 20px; overflow: auto; } .ds-tabs button { min-height: 44px; border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; background: none; padding: 12px 16px; color: var(--ui-muted, #526277); font: inherit; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tabs button[aria-selected="true"] { color: var(--ui-accent, #245aca); border-bottom-color: var(--ui-accent, #245aca); } .ds-tabs button:hover { background: var(--ui-background, #ffffff); } .ds-tabs button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ui-accent, #245aca); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Status badge
components.description: Compact supporting status; no implied action.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-self: flex-start; gap: 4px; border: 1px solid var(--ui-border, #dce2e8); border-radius: 99px; padding: 3px 10px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--ui-foreground, #192638); }

components.name: Independent tool card
components.description: A fine boundary identifies an independent tool without adding a shadow.
components.html:
Energy estimate

Use the current settings to compare consumption.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--ui-surface, #ffffff); color: var(--ui-foreground, #192638); border: 1px solid var(--ui-border, #dce2e8); border-radius: var(--ui-radius, 12px); padding: 24px; min-width: 0; } .ds-card h2 { margin: 0 0 16px; font-family: var(--ui-heading, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 20px; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; max-width: 72ch; white-space: pre-wrap; }

components.name: Open control panel
components.description: Related controls stay together in a plain column beside or below the visual.
components.html:
Rotation

30°
components.css: .ds-panel { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; color: var(--ui-foreground, #192638); } .ds-panel h3 { margin: 0; } .ds-slider { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; min-height: 44px; } .ds-slider input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; min-height: 44px; margin: 0; touch-action: pan-y; accent-color: var(--ui-accent, #245aca); } .ds-slider output { min-width: 40px; text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-slider input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ui-accent, #245aca); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Interactive scene
components.description: Responsive typed SVG with description, selection and visible keyboard focus.
components.css: .ds-scene { position: relative; margin: 0; } .ds-scene svg { width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; min-height: 240px; } .ds-scene circle { stroke: var(--ui-border, #dce2e8); } .ds-scene g[role="button"] { cursor: pointer; } .ds-scene g[aria-pressed="true"] > circle { stroke: var(--ui-accent, #245aca); stroke-width: 4; } .ds-scene g:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ui-accent, #245aca); outline-offset: 4px; }

narrative.overview:
Engine's reference lab is a quiet workspace for making, inspecting and comparing an interface. Embedded MeldUI answers follow the same restrained character: the useful diagram, media or tool carries the composition, with concise text and controls supporting it. The SDK is a reference surface rather than a separately branded marketing page.

Neutral supplies cool white paper, dark ink and restrained blue. Editorial retains warm paper, deep green and serif headings. Both support light and dark modes without changing the answer's data or controls. Hosts can replace typography, tokens and trusted component views so an answer fits its surrounding service.
keyCharacteristics: Open, responsive composition and restrained borders.
Host typography, media and component ownership.
Local interaction state preserved across kit changes.
Keyboard, text alternatives and reduced-motion support.

rules.name: The Active Kit Rule
rules.body: Resolve every shared foreground, surface, boundary and interaction color from the active kit; keep host components in that same theme contract.

rules.name: The Host Type Rule
rules.body: Embedded answers may inherit the host's body and heading families; kit changes preserve component meaning and state.

rules.name: The Quiet Surface Rule
rules.body: Use open layout for related content and a bordered container only when it identifies an independent tool, field or content boundary.

dos: **Do** lead with the smallest useful representation of the requested task and one subject-specific visual when it helps.
**Do** place useful controls beside or below the visual as the available container allows.
**Do** keep input labels, units, formatted numbers and text alternatives explicit.
**Do** resolve styling from the active kit or host theme while preserving local state.
**Do** retain visible focus, keyboard access, accessible chart alternatives and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: **Don't** force a quiz, callout, repeated heading or decorative metric into every answer.
**Don't** nest cards to group content that already belongs together in an open layout.
**Don't** impose a fixed content height without the host's explicit height policy.
**Don't** make the reference frame or demo navigation mandatory in a host embedding.
**Don't** promote a host-specific override into a shared kit rule.
